prompts.name: anth_cover
prompts.prompt: Vertical 4:5 photorealistic editorial news photo, cinematic. Times Square style giant curved Nasdaq LED screen at night showing a large stock ticker 'ANT' with a red falling price chart line and red down arrow, wet street reflections, crowd silhouettes in the foreground looking up, cold blue and alarming red lighting. Ominous, tense mood like 'is this a warning?'. Keep the bottom 40% dark and simple for a headline. No other readable text, no company logos, no watermark.
